summary: Implement the loop-engineering workflow pattern into the PP Namias portfolio. This introduces STATE.md (live loop state), LOOP.md (documented active loops), loop-budget.md (token/cost guards), and loop-run-log.md (run history). It wires up GitHub Actions for Daily Triage, PR Babysitter, and Dependency Sweeper patterns. The existing skills, subagents, and CI workflows are preserved and enhanced — not replaced. The goal is to move from ad-hoc agent prompting to designed loops that prompt agents on a cadence.
narrative: The portfolio already has 21 GitHub Actions workflows, 5 subagents, 40+ skills, and a mature react-doctor quality gate. But these operate independently — there is no central state file tracking what loops are active, no budget guardrails on token spend, and no run history for observability. Loop engineering introduces a thin coordination layer: STATE.md as the single source of truth for loop health, LOOP.md documenting which loops run and why, loop-budget.md setting daily caps, and loop-run-log.md recording every automated run. This PRD adds these files, wires them into existing CI, and introduces three production loops adapted from the loop-engineering reference: Daily Triage (L1, report-only), PR Babysitter (L2, assisted), and Dependency Sweeper (L2, patch-only). Each loop runs in isolated worktrees where code changes are attempted, with human gates on major decisions.
principles: Augment, don't replace — the existing 21 workflows, skills, and subagents stay intact. Loop engineering adds coordination on top.
STATE.md is the spine — every loop reads and writes STATE.md. It is the single source of truth for what is active, what is blocked, and what needs human attention.
Budget-first — every loop has a daily token cap. Exceeding the cap pauses the scheduler and opens a maintainer issue.
Worktrees for code changes — any loop that attempts a code fix runs in an isolated git worktree. One worktree per fix; discard on failure.
Human gates on majors — loops propose, humans decide. Patch-only auto-apply in week 1. Majors and denylisted packages always require human approval.
One story slice per commit — planning, state files, workflows, skills, tests, docs are separate commits.
No comments in code — the only documentation is the PRD, STATE.md, LOOP.md, and skill files.

LOOP.md documents at least 3 active loops with cadence and gates
loop-budget.md defines daily token caps for each loop

designDecisions.choice: STATE.md at repo root (same level as AGENTS.md, LOOP.md).
designDecisions.rationale: Matches the loop-engineering reference. Agents and workflows find it immediately without path guessing.

designDecisions.choice: LOOP.md at repo root, documenting each active loop's cadence, skill, state file, phase, and handoff rules.
designDecisions.rationale: Single file any agent can read to understand the full loop catalog. Mirrors the reference repo pattern.

designDecisions.choice: loop-budget.md with a markdown table: loop name, max runs/day, max tokens/day, max sub-agent spawns/run.
designDecisions.rationale: Human-readable, git-diffable, no external tooling needed. The reference repo uses the same format.

designDecisions.choice: loop-run-log.md with timestamped entries appended by workflows. Each entry: date, loop name, finding summary, action taken, token cost estimate.
designDecisions.rationale: Append-only log is simple, auditable, and doesn't require a database. Workflows use `echo >> loop-run-log.md`.

designDecisions.choice: L1 report-only. Runs on weekday schedule, reads open issues/PRs, checks react-doctor score, checks dependency status, writes findings to STATE.md. No code changes.
designDecisions.rationale: Lowest risk starting point. Owner reviews STATE.md and decides what to act on. Matches L1 phase in loop-engineering.

designDecisions.choice: L2 assisted. Triggers on PR open/update. Runs lint, typecheck, test, react-doctor in a worktree. Suggests fixes as comments. No auto-merge.
designDecisions.rationale: Adds value on every PR without risk. Worktree isolation prevents side effects. Human merges.

designDecisions.choice: L2 patch-only. Runs on schedule (6h). Checks npm audit, OSV scanner. Creates PRs for patch updates only. Major updates go to STATE.md watch list.
designDecisions.rationale: Patch updates are low-risk and safe to auto-PR. Majors need human review. Matches the reference repo's 30-day patch-only policy.

designDecisions.choice: GitHub label `loop-pause-all`. When present, all loop workflows check for the label and skip execution.
designDecisions.rationale: Simple, visible, reversible. One label click pauses everything. Matches the reference repo pattern.

designDecisions.choice: Loop workflows call existing npm scripts (npm run lint, npm run test, npm run doctor) rather than duplicating logic. STATE.md supplements — does not replace — existing workflow outputs.
designDecisions.rationale: Zero duplication. Loops leverage the mature toolchain already in place.

designDecisions.choice: One commit per story slice. Message format: type(scope): summary. Every file addition, workflow, and config change gets its own commit.
designDecisions.rich: Maximizes commit history as requested. Each slice is independently revertable.

epics.title: Core state files
epics.summary: Create the four foundational files: STATE.md, LOOP.md, loop-budget.md, loop-run-log.md. These are the spine of the loop-engineering system.

stories.title: Create STATE.md with initial structure
stories.details: Create STATE.md at repo root. Sections: Last run timestamp, High Priority (active loops waiting on human), Watch List (items to monitor), Recent Noise (ignored this run), Run log reference. Initialize with current date and empty sections.

stories.title: Create LOOP.md documenting active loops
stories.details: Create LOOP.md at repo root. Document each loop: name, cadence, skill/workflow file, state reference, phase (L1/L2/L3), handoff rules. Start with 3 loops: Daily Triage, PR Babysitter, Dependency Sweeper. Include multi-loop priority ordering.

stories.title: Create loop-budget.md with token caps
stories.details: Create loop-budget.md at repo root. Table format: loop name, max runs/day, max tokens/day, max sub-agent spawns/run. Include budget exceed handling (pause, log, open issue). Include kill switch documentation.

stories.title: Create loop-run-log.md with append-only format
stories.details: Create loop-run-log.md at repo root. Header explaining the format. Initial entry with today's date and 'System initialized'. Workflows will append entries via echo >> loop-run-log.md.

epics.title: Daily Triage workflow
epics.summary: Create .github/workflows/daily-triage.yml — an L1 report-only loop that runs on weekday mornings, checks repo health, and updates STATE.md with findings.

stories.title: Create daily-triage.yml workflow file
stories.details: Create .github/workflows/daily-triage.yml. Schedule: cron weekday mornings (e.g. 8am UTC). Trigger: schedule + manual workflow_dispatch. Steps: checkout, check for loop-pause-all label, run npm run lint, run npm run test -- --run, run npm run doctor -- --json, check npm audit, check open issues/PRs count, append summary to loop-run-log.md, update STATE.md with findings. All steps use existing npm scripts.

stories.title: Add loop-pause-all label check to workflow
stories.details: Add a step at the start of daily-triage.yml that checks if the loop-pause-all label exists on the repo. If present, skip all subsequent steps and log 'Paused by loop-pause-all label' to loop-run-log.md.

stories.title: Add STATE.md update step
stories.details: Add a step that generates the STATE.md content from workflow outputs. Use a script or inline bash to overwrite STATE.md sections: Last run timestamp, High Priority items from failed checks, Watch List from dependency warnings, Recent Noise from ignored items.

stories.title: Add loop-run-log.md append step
stories.details: Add a step that appends a timestamped entry to loop-run-log.md with: date, loop name (daily-triage), summary of findings, actions taken (report only), estimated token cost (low for L1).

epics.title: PR Babysitter workflow
epics.summary: Create .github/workflows/pr-babysitter.yml — an L2 assisted loop that triggers on PR events, runs quality checks, and suggests fixes as PR comments.

stories.title: Create pr-babysitter.yml workflow file
stories.details: Create .github/workflows/pr-babysitter.yml. Trigger: pull_request opened, synchronize, reopened. Steps: checkout PR branch, check loop-pause-all label, run npm run lint (capture output), run npm run test -- --run (capture output), run npm run doctor -- --json (capture output), run npx tsc --noEmit (capture output). If any step fails, post a PR comment with the failure summary and suggested fix.

stories.title: Add PR comment posting step
stories.details: Use actions/github-script or similar to post a comment on the PR when checks fail. Comment format: emoji status, failed check name, error summary, suggested fix (if deterministic, e.g. 'run npm run lint --fix'), link to full workflow run. Only comment on first failure; don't spam on every push.

stories.title: Add react-doctor score to PR comment
stories.details: When react-doctor score drops below 100, include the score and specific findings in the PR comment. Reference the fix-react-doctor-finding skill for resolution steps.

stories.title: Add run log append for PR babysitter
stories.details: Append entry to loop-run-log.md for each PR check: date, loop name (pr-babysitter), PR number, checks run, result (pass/fail), actions taken (comment posted or none).

epics.title: Dependency Sweeper workflow
epics.summary: Create .github/workflows/dependency-sweeper.yml — an L2 patch-only loop that checks for vulnerable/outdated dependencies and creates PRs for safe updates.

stories.title: Create dependency-sweeper.yml workflow file
stories.details: Create .github/workflows/dependency-sweeper.yml. Schedule: every 6 hours. Trigger: schedule + manual workflow_dispatch. Steps: checkout, check loop-pause-all label, run npm audit --json, run npm outdated --json (parse for patch updates only), filter to patch semver bumps only, create a branch and PR for each eligible update. Major/minor updates go to STATE.md watch list.

stories.title: Add patch-only filtering logic
stories.details: Write a bash/node step that parses npm outdated output and filters to only patch version bumps (e.g. 1.2.3 -> 1.2.4). Major and minor updates are logged to STATE.md watch list but not auto-PR'd. Include denylist for packages that should never be auto-updated (e.g. next, react, sanity packages).

stories.title: Add PR creation step
stories.details: Use peter-evans/create-pull-request or similar to create a PR for each eligible patch update. PR title: 'chore(deps): bump {package} from {old} to {new}'. PR body: changelog link, test results, risk assessment. Label: 'dependencies'.

stories.title: Add STATE.md watch list update
stories.details: When major/minor updates are detected, append them to the Watch List section of STATE.md with a note like 'Major update available: {package} {old} -> {new}. Manual review required.'

stories.title: Add run log append for dependency sweeper
stories.details: Append entry to loop-run-log.md: date, loop name (dependency-sweeper), patches found, PRs created, majors/minor logged to watch list, estimated token cost (medium).

epics.title: Loop integration with existing systems
epics.summary: Wire the loop-engineering files into the existing skills, AGENTS.md, and feature flags system. Ensure loops are discoverable by agents.

stories.title: Update AGENTS.md with loop-engineering section
stories.details: Add a 'Loop Engineering' section to AGENTS.md documenting: STATE.md location, LOOP.md location, loop-budget.md, loop-run-log.md, kill switch (loop-pause-all label), how agents should read STATE.md before starting work, and the three active loops.

stories.title: Add loop-engineering skill
stories.details: Create .agents/skills/loop-engineering/SKILL.md documenting: what loop engineering is, the five building blocks, how to read STATE.md, how to append to loop-run-log.md, budget limits, kill switch, and the three active patterns. Reference the loop-engineering repo for advanced patterns.

stories.title: Add loop-related npm scripts
stories.details: Add to package.json scripts: 'loop:audit' (echoes current loop readiness), 'loop:status' (cat STATE.md), 'loop:log' (tail loop-run-log.md). These are convenience wrappers, not new tools.

epics.title: Tests for loop workflows
epics.summary: Add tests validating the loop-engineering files exist, have correct structure, and workflows reference valid npm scripts.

stories.title: Add STATE.md structure test
stories.details: Add a test that validates STATE.md exists at repo root, contains required sections (Last run, High Priority, Watch List, Recent Noise), and is valid markdown.

stories.title: Add LOOP.md structure test
stories.details: Add a test that validates LOOP.md exists, contains at least 3 loop entries, each with cadence, skill, and phase documented.

stories.title: Add loop-budget.md structure test
stories.details: Add a test that validates loop-budget.md exists, contains a table with at least 3 loops, each with max runs/day and max tokens/day defined.

stories.title: Add workflow file validation tests
stories.details: Add tests that validate each loop workflow YAML file exists, is valid YAML, contains the loop-pause-all label check, and references only existing npm scripts.

epics.title: Verification
epics.summary: Run the full quality gate to ensure loop-engineering additions don't break anything.

stories.title: Run tsc, eslint, vitest
stories.details: Run: npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint, npm run test -- --run. All must pass with the new loop-engineering tests included.

stories.title: Run react-doctor
stories.details: Run npm run doctor. Score must stay at 100/100. No new findings from the added files.

stories.title: Validate workflow YAML syntax
stories.details: Run actionlint or yamllint on all three new workflow files to catch syntax errors.
